purpose: Whole input-chain review: on-demand character segmentation and exactly-once candidate dispatch
kept: latest default engine management, CharacterStyle rendering and fonts (PR32 font change is not included)
native SDK and real key/release processing
ordered owner/commit/session gates and learned dictionary semantics
candidate selection identities and gesture timing

formal.block: Three ABBA and three BAAB blocks per VM, shuffled by the frozen seed
formal.unit: Within-block mean current minus mean baseline; 6 independent paired block observations per VM; keep VMs separate

profile.diagnostics: Same ordinary Debug APK, INPUT_DIAGNOSTICS=false; platform/UI/RenderThread traces only, not native per-key timing.

interpretation.stable_speedup: A cold metric negative paired median and >=5/6 faster blocks in BOTH VMs; neither cold metric positive median BOTH VMs; no warm metric positive median and >=4/6 slower BOTH VMs
interpretation.regression_signal: A cold metric positive paired median and >=4/6 slower blocks in BOTH VMs; report absolute deltas and all raw signs, no exclusion of adverse samples
interpretation.decision: Correctness fixes and eliminated work are reported separately from end-to-end speed. If no stable speedup, do not claim one. Do not merge or overwrite PR32 code automatically; preserve exact reviewed work on one branch for review.
interpretation.limits: Not a formal noninferiority test. No phone/ARM/Release/throughput/P95 claims; first i ends at IME window UP, selection ends at IC entry.

baseline_correction: Before any build/sample: moved the two product commits from stale PR32 base to actual remote default 88a664d4; native engine management remains intact. No old-base samples exist.
